fields.label: Upgrades at level 1 (paid in Divinity Points)
value: Lets you click the volcano, linking the divinity of your choice to ALL players! Also, 1.1x Divinity EXP gain for all!
The Max Level of the ''Blessing'' upgrade for each Divinity is +2 levels higher!
God Rank now also gives 1.01x Class EXP to all players!
Divinity Skill Lv boosts Minor Link Bonuses a bit more!
Boosts Divinity PTS gain by +2% per Coral Reef upgrade!
You now generate 2.4% more Daily Coral for the Coral Reef back in W7 town!

fields.label: Upgrade cost
fields.value: 10,000,000 Divinity Points for the first upgrade, 6x more for each one after it; every level costs 1.1x more (1.25x for the second)

fields.label: Page 2 upgrades at level 1 (paid in Singularity Spirals)
value: You can Transmute Divinity PTS into Singularity Spirals! Get Time Elapse by claiming Divinity AFK. Also, 2x Div PTS
The base value of the Transmute, which is based on how many Divinity PTS you have, is now 1.1x higher!
Your Divinity EXP gain for all characters is boosted by a staggering 1.5x
You now get Time Elapsed when claiming any AFK Gains, not just from Divinity skill! However, you only get 1% as many hours.
Boosts your Lumi hourly gain over at the Luminous Menagerie by a massive 1.05x
Each God Rank above 25 now also gives 1.01x DMG to all players!

fields.label: Page 2 upgrade cost
fields.value: 1, 9, 121, 2,197, 28,561 and 759,375 Singularity Spirals for its upgrades in order; every level costs 1.13x more (1.85x for the fifth and sixth)

god:DivGod0.name: Snehebatu
god:DivGod0.description: +30%_AFK_Gains_for_all_activities! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +70%_accuracy_and_+70%_defence. Blessing: +{%_Divinity_PTS_Gain.

god:DivGod1.name: Arctis
god:DivGod1.description: This_character_is_always_active_within_the_Lab_Mainframe._However,_they_will_not_gain_any_Lab_EXP! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +15_Talent_LV_for_all_talents_above_Lv_1. Blessing: +{%_Divinity_PTS_Gain.

god:DivGod2.name: Nobisect
god:DivGod2.description: All_kills_count_for_2x_more_kills_for_opening_portals_and_accumulating_Deathnote_kills. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +200%_Total_Damage. Blessing: +{_All_Skill_Efficiency.

god:DivGod3.name: Harriep
god:DivGod3.description: This_character_produces_3x_more_resources_at_3d_Printer!_Works_with_the_Lab_Bonus,_but_won't_affect_the_displayed_printer_amount. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +100%_coins_gained_for_ALL_characters! Blessing: +{%_Divinity_PTS_Gain.

god:DivGod4.name: Goharut
god:DivGod4.description: Being_connected_to_the_Lab_also_counts_as_being_present_at_the_Divinity_Altar,_so_you_get_gains_for_both! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +5%_AFK_Gains_for_ALL_characters! Blessing: +{%_Sailing_Speed.

god:DivGod5.name: Omniphau
god:DivGod5.description: When_claiming_non-candy_AFK_gains,_also_progress_one_of_the_following_by_the_AFK_time!_(Refinery,_3D_Printer,_Cooking,_Mob_Breeding,_Sailing,_or_Gaming) Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +100%_Class_EXP. Blessing: +{%_Divinity_PTS_Gain.

god:DivGod6.name: Purrmep
god:DivGod6.description: All_characters_produce_2x_more_Divinity,_and_get_2x_more_Divinity_EXP!_Only_1_player_can_link_to_Purrmep. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +50%_Boat_Sailing_speed_and_+50%_Gaming_Plant_grow_speed. Blessing: +{%_Sailing_Speed.

god:DivGod7.name: Flutterbis
god:DivGod7.description: Whenever_you_level_up_a_skill_thats_over_Lv_50,_a_Divinity_Pearl_will_drop_which_gives_+40%_exp_to_any_skill_under_Lv_50! Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +150%_skill_exp. Blessing: +{%_Total_Damage.

god:DivGod8.name: Kattlekruk
god:DivGod8.description: Every_day_you_play,_you_get_+20_LV_for_some_Alchemy_Bubbles._Only_1_player_can_link_here. Minor bonus for a linked character, at most: +10%_chance_for_2x_Statue_Drops,_for_ALL_characters! Blessing: +{%_Total_Damage.
